home.heading: Vuetify and Tailwind, side by side
home.body: The button below is a Vuetify component. The layout around it is Tailwind. Neither reaches into the other.

rtl.heading: Right-to-left verification
rtl.body: Switch the language and confirm two things move together: the Vuetify card mirrors, and the Tailwind logical spacing swaps sides.
rtl.cardBody: This card is a Vuetify component inside a Tailwind grid. The spacing uses ps- and pe-, so it follows the reading direction instead of a fixed side.
rtl.startSide: This block has ps-6 (padding at the start)
rtl.endSide: This block has pe-6 (padding at the end)
